TGA_specimen_preparation: Approximately 4 mg of the source-labelled fabric after the documented wash, drying and conditioning sequence. TG pan and cutting or grinding details are not reported. The 10 mg specimen belongs to separate TG-FTIR, not conventional TG.
LOI_specimen_preparation: Cotton fabric strips 140 × 50 mm. Table 2 footnote explicitly gives five wash cycles, drying and conditioning before all fire tests. Five LOI specimens were tested for an average.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Table SI-5 treated cellulose textile labels with matching post-wash phosphorus values; neat Poly-A and Poly-B are separate non-textile rows.
source_version: Final published journal article and its official institutional supplementary material
source_numeric_evidence_description: Exact main Table 2 measured LOI values, with ±0.2 in column heading, paired to exact nitrogen/air Table SI-5 TG. Source-defined Tdmax is the DTG maximum; R800 temperature is explicit. Original PDF pixels inspected.
source_onset_definition: Source Tdonset is the temperature at 97% mass remaining, excluding moisture. Stored source-native only; not converted to T5 or T10.
source_recipe_holds: No steam recipe assigned to the blank. Source laundering standard edition is unresolved, while the physical protocol is explicit.
washing_protocol: One accelerated wash operation simulating five home laundry cycles: sandwich a 152.4 × 50.8 mm specimen between two multifiber test fabrics and stitch the edges. Use 0.225 g ECE 98 detergent, 150 mL demineralized water and 50 steel balls in an Atlas Launder-O-Meter LEF at 49 °C for 45 min. Rinse three times with demineralized water, dry at 60 °C for 2 h and condition in standard atmosphere for 24 h before other characterization. SI-4 prepares three wash specimens per sample. The main and SI heading cite AATCC 61-1996; SI procedural text and silver durability prose cite AATCC 61-2013, so standard edition remains source-conflicted.

limitations: Eight prepared textile/wash states with sixteen atmospheric TG conditions. All LOI rows are after five simulated home laundry cycles, not unwashed. Table 4 uses representative chemistry names and rounds TPTEPO LOI to 27.4; no add-on or label crosswalk is inferred from that comparison table. Source laundering standard editions conflict; explicit physical wash conditions are retained.
LOI_locator: Final article p 6, Table 2, exact Blank/S9/S10/S11/S12/S14/S15/SS1 rows and five-wash footnote. LOI mean of five specimens in section 2.2.6 p 4; ±0.2 from the Table 2 header.
LOI_method: ASTM D2863-97; FTT oxygen index apparatus; five specimens tested and mean reported.
TG_locator: Official supplement p 15, Table SI-5: source Tdonset, explicitly DTG-defined Tdmax and residue at 800 °C for nitrogen and air.
conditions_locator: Final article p 4, sections 2.1 and 2.2.2-2.2.6; SI pp 6-9, sections SI-3.3 through SI-4. TG: approximately 4 mg, 25-800 °C, N2 and air, total gas flow 50 mL/min, 10 °C/min. Wash procedure: SI p 9.
pairing_evidence: Main Table 2 explicitly reports fire tests after five wash cycles. SI-4 states rinsed, dried and conditioned washed samples precede other characterization and analysis. For each treated fabric, Table SI-5 TG repeats the exact phosphorus value and uncertainty in the post-five-wash Table 1/SI-3/SI-4 column and main LOI Table 2. Labels and P values jointly identify the same states. Blank appears in both assay tables; Table 2 all-samples wash footnote and shared characterization procedure apply. No 50-wash state or neat polymer is substituted.

Dissolve TVPO and TPT at the consistent 1:1 molar ratio in absolute ethanol and apply with a syringe. Apply the solution evenly to conditioned cotton in a petri dish, with half on each side, and stand for 15 min. Source describes solution volume as twice fabric weight, without explicit volume units. Steam on a needle frame at 110 °C and 0.4 bar above atmospheric pressure for 1 h. Rinse with warm water for 10 min, dry and condition for 24 h at 20 °C and 65% RH before the accelerated durability wash. Actual P before/after washing is 1.02 ± 0.02% / 1.00 ± 0.02%. One accelerated wash operation simulating five home laundry cycles: sandwich a 152.4 × 50.8 mm specimen between two multifiber test fabrics and stitch the edges. Use 0.225 g ECE 98 detergent, 150 mL demineralized water and 50 steel balls in an Atlas Launder-O-Meter LEF at 49 °C for 45 min. Rinse three times with demineralized water, dry at 60 °C for 2 h and condition in standard atmosphere for 24 h before other characterization. SI-4 prepares three wash specimens per sample. treatment_chemistry: Table 1 and Table 2: DATPPO:ODA molar ratio 6:4, with stoichiometric s-BPDA. DATPPO is [2,5-bis(4-aminophenoxy)phenyl] diphenylphosphine oxide; PI-0 is the ODA/s-BPDA control.
treatment_method: s-BPDA dried overnight under vacuum at 260 °C. DATPPO and ODA reacted with a stoichiometric quantity of s-BPDA in DMAc under nitrogen at room temperature for 24 h; solids 15 wt% of total solution. PAA solution filtered and degassed, then dry-jet wet spun through a 50-hole spinneret of 0.12 mm hole diameter into water/DMAc 42:58 by volume. Filaments passed a washing bath and heating oven and were collected on winders. PAA fibers heated to 300 °C to form PI fibers, followed by drawing. Table 1 assigns the unprimed PI-0 through PI-6 series draft ratio 3.0 and draw ratio 1.6; draw temperature and residence time are not stated. DATPPO monomer synthesis is documented in the official three-page SI; no durability laundering is reported.
source_title: Synthesis and Properties of Novel Polyimide Fibers Containing Phosphorus Groups in the Side Chain (DATPPO)
source_location: Published p.378, PDF p.7, Table 2 T5, T10 and CR columns, footnotes a and b.; Published p.378, PDF p.7, Table 2 column LOI d and footnote d; adjacent paragraph explicitly distinguishes measured and calculated LOI.; Published pp.373–375, PDF pp.2–4, preparation and Table 1; p.376, PDF p.5, Characterization; official SI pp.1–3.
limitations: LOI is the measured Table 2 column d, supported by the HC-2C instrument and the adjacent experimental-LOI prose. Column c is calculated from char yield by the van Krevelen equation and is excluded. LOI standard, geometry or mounting, conditioning, replicate count and uncertainty are not reported. The at least 10 filaments and GB/T 14337 apply only to tensile testing, and the aluminum pan applies only to DSC; neither is assigned to TG or LOI. TG aliquot mass, pan, gas flow and cutting or grinding are not reported. Figure 3 displays 400–850 °C, whereas the method explicitly states acquisition from 30–850 °C. The approximate derivative regions near 550 and 600 °C are not extracted as exact Tmax values. PI-6 prime and double-prime draw variants have mechanical data only and receive no TG/LOI transfer. Related main-chain DAMPO source 10.1039/c6ra02344d uses a different monomer and draft ratio 3.8; its control TG tuple differs and its methods do not report an LOI assay. Related AO source 10.1039/c6ra26941a uses the same DATPPO family: pre-exposure states require future reuse review, and no AO-exposed state is assigned these initial measurements.
